mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CASE r.data_scope WHEN 'own' THEN 0 WHEN 'team' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.enterprise_id = ur.enterprise_id AND r.id = ur.role_id JOIN enterprise_member m ON m.enterprise_id = ur.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = m.enterprise_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.enterprise_id = r.enterprise_id AND rp.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND r.status = 'active' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = 'active' AND u.status = 'active' AND e.status = 'active' AND rp.permission_code = #{permission}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.enterprise_id = ur.enterprise_id AND r.id = ur.role_id JOIN enterprise_member m ON m.enterprise_id = ur.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE ur.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND r.code = 'enterprise-admin' AND r.builtin = TRUE AND r.status = 'active' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status = 'active' AND u.status = 'active'
